# Rahmat Hidayat

> Software engineer and digital marketer in Makassar, Indonesia. Engineering Lead at Afila and founder of Thuuba, a digital marketing agency. Builds software and AI agents and runs performance marketing.

## About

- Engineering Lead at Afila (https://afila.co.id), leading the team behind E-SAKIP, E-Monev and Dikerja, platforms local governments in Indonesia use to plan, measure and report their work.
- Founder of Thuuba (https://thuuba.web.id), a digital marketing agency running performance marketing on Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads.
- Builds AI agents and agent workflows for engineering and marketing work.
- Works with Laravel, Vue.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Go and PostgreSQL.
